powers: When you would discard a spell for a power on a boon that has the Staff trait, you may discard or bury a blessing (☐ or any boon) instead.
On any check, when you would discard a blessing, you may bury it instead.
You may recharge a buried blessing to (☐ succeed at your check to recharge a spell or to) reroll the dice (☐ or 1 die) on any of your checks; take the new result.
☐ You may put Magus Arcana on top of your deck to add a die to your (☐ or another character at your location's) check that invokes the Outsider or Undead (☐ or Magic) trait.
☐ You may bury a blessing to reduce damage dealt to you (☐ or to another character at your location) by 3.
☐ For each of your buried blessings, add 1 to your check that invokes the Outsider or Undead traits (☐ or to any of your checks).

roles.name: Staff Master
powers: When you would discard a spell for a power on a boon that has the Staff trait, you may discard or bury (☐ or recharge) a blessing (☐ or any boon) instead.
On any check, when you would discard a blessing, you may bury it instead (☐ then draw a card).
You may recharge a buried blessing to (☐ succeed at your check to recharge a spell or to) reroll the dice (☐ or 1 die) on any of your checks; take the new result.
☐ When you would recharge (☐ or discard) a spell, you may reveal a card that has the Staff trait to instead put the spell on top of your deck.
☐ If any die rolled on your check is a 1, count it as a 3 (☐ or reroll any of those dice).
☐ When you discard 1 or more cards as damage, you may recharge a buried blessing.
